channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Finland Proves Defense Can Prevail As They Claim Bronze
item.description: At this year's Olympics, Team Finland shook off a tough semifinal loss to Canada on Friday, overwhelming Slovakia 6-1 on Saturday to win the Olympic bronze medal.

item.title: Canada's Sidney Crosby Ruled Out For Gold Medal Game Against Team USA At The Olympics
item.description: Both Canada and the U.S. will go with the same lineup from Friday's semifinal.

item.title: USA Beat Canada In OT For First Olympic Men's Hockey Gold Medal Since 1980
item.description: Team USA's Jack Hughes scored in overtime to beat Canada 2-1 in Sunday's gold medal game at the Olympics.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Reacting To USA Beating Canada For Men's Hockey Gold
item.description: Andrew McInnis, Michael Augello and our correspondents in Milan went live to recap Team USA beating Team Canada 2-1 in the men's hockey gold medal game.

item.title: Team USA Celebrates Olympic Gold With Gaudreau Brothers In Mind: 'We Did It For Them'
item.description: A year-and-a-half since the deaths of Johnny and Matthew Gaudreau, the U.S. men's hockey team celebrated gold with them in mind. Dylan Larkin even mused that they were there spiritually on the ice during some close moments.

item.title: Canada's Jon Cooper Blasts OT Format After Gold Medal Game: 'There's A Reason Why 3-On-3 Is Not In The Stanley Cup Final'
item.description: Team Canada coach Jon Cooper said he's not using the 3-on-3 overtime as an excuse for losing the gold medal game. But he said taking four players off the ice made the hockey "not hockey anymore."

item.title: NHL Nugget: Remembering T.J. Oshie's Shootout Heroics In Sochi
item.description: During the 2014 Winter Games in Sochi, T.J. Oshie scored four times in one shootout to help beat Russia.

item.title: In Hindsight, Maybe A Less-Than-Healthy Sidney Crosby Should Have Chosen To Play
item.description: Team Canada captain Sidney Crosby said he decided against playing in the gold medal game due to his injury. But he added if he could play, then he would've been out there.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Three Stars Of The Tournament Feature The MVP And Best Goalie
item.description: The three biggest standouts of the Olympic men's hockey tournament were at different positions – and came from different countries.

item.title: Cheers To 2026 Olympic Hockey: Are You Not Entertained?
item.description: The 2026 Olympic men's hockey tournament featured thrilling games, unexpected upsets and dominant performances that captivated fans. No matter which country you were pulling for to win gold, you had to be a fan of the caliber of the games we saw.
